members.name: GetRunningApplications
members.reason: the schema publishes no application object; the window list is what this adapter serves

members.name: GetWindows
members.note: the window dict carries title, app-id, wm-class, is-hidden, has-focus, width and height from the `window` object; client-type is always 0 because the schema does not publish whether a surface is Wayland or X11, and is-hidden is always false because it publishes no hidden state

members.name: AnimationsEnabled
members.note: always true: the IPC publishes no animations switch yet, and a caller that reads false would disable its own animations for no reason
